newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end quiet trade mostly weaker.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end quiet trade mostly weaker.

text.p: April 16 - IMM currency futures ended very quiet afternoon trading mostly weaker. Futures barely downticked late as U.S. bonds cut losses, stocks extended gains. Focus on U.S. Feb trade gap report Thursday, especially deficit with Japan. Overall shortfall forecast at $10.1 billion vs Jan's $12.71 billion gap. Yen rose mainly on intervention jitters.
